name: Visne Madencilik Uretim Sanayi ve Tct AS
summary: Visne Madencilik Uretim Sanayi ve Ticaret AS primarily operates in the field of lime manufacturing. The company's product line includes quicklime, slaked lime, aggregate materials, and a specialized agent known as 'vikalo,' which functions as a moisture and gas absorbent. This Turkish enterprise, headquartered in Izmir, was established on March 23, 1952, by a group of founders consisting of Nesim Avram Menekse, Hüseyin Remzi Çaglayan, Mehmet Bolcakan, Ermin Serhat Yildiz, Pinar Yildiz, and Erdal Ekinci.
